data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.war_summary: War 139 is on day 113 with no winner. Colonials hold a dominant strategic position with approximately 185 bases to Wardens' 65 across 40 regions. The most intense combat zones are Endless Shore, Callahans Passage, Oarbreaker, Clahstra, Godcrofts, and Marban Hollow, where both factions are sustaining heavy casualties with accelerating trends and active base flipping. Endless Shore shows the highest intensity (1,750+ casualties/hr per side) with 49 events/24h across 5 active bases and a latest event at 05:36 UTC. Callahans Passage follows with 1,500+ casualties/hr per side and 6 events/24h. Oarbreaker leads in event volume (46 events/24h) with rapid base turnover across 5 bases and a latest event at 08:26 UTC. Clahstra has 13 events/24h with 3 highly active bases and a latest event at 07:41 UTC. Godcrofts shows 27 events/24h with accelerating casualties and a recent event at 08:41 UTC. Marban Hollow has surged to 2,500+ casualties/hr per side with accelerating trends and a latest event at 06:56 UTC. Wardens hold quiet northern regions (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead, Howl County, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse, Speaking Woods, Reaching Trail) but face heavy pressure in Speaking Woods (1,700+ casualties/2h). Large Colonial rear areas (Deadlands, Drowned Vale, Allods Bight, etc.) are quiet with minimal casualties.
